race.comment: STAY HUMBLE (1) has been about the money with three minor placings from four starts this campaign, the latest a solid second over 1400m at Sandown-Lakeside. Will find this a touch easier and has good early toe, so he should be handy in the run. ALIEN ANGEL (7) is a lightly raced mare from France who was far from disgraced to finish 1.4 lengths away in fifth last start over 1400m at Seymour after a win the run before. Looks to have plenty of upside. TRANGOOJAHRAY (3) has not won for a long while, last racing on August 8 when beaten 3.5 lengths into fourth at Caulfield Heath over 1600m. Has the class to return to the winners' list. OCEAN BAY (5) returned from a spell last start with a strong win by a long neck over 1300m at Bendigo. Will be better for that latest run and she looms as a significant threat.
